node: AI optical connectivity production chain: lasers, compound-semiconductor epitaxy, wafers, and epitaxy tools
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the less-obvious layers beneath AI optical transceivers: InP laser production tools, InP substrate wafers, photonics manufacturing subsystems, and advanced laser/component capacity. The strongest underfollowed direct fit is VECO, which has disclosed large InP laser manufacturing equipment orders tied to 800G/1.6T optical transceivers. AXTI is a wafer-substrate chokepoint candidate with direct InP exposure but export-control and China/Tongmei complexity. MKSI is a broader subsystem and photonics-enabling pick-and-shovel candidate with more indirect node linkage. LITE is included as a reference/customer-capacity anchor rather than an underfollowed name after its NVIDIA-linked capacity disclosures and S&P 500 transition.
